rapc-01-c2.text: Catholic Encyclopedia (1911). Montanists. New Advent (The Catholic Encyclopedia, vol. 10).
rapc-01-c2.quote: After me there shall be no prophetess, but the end.
rapc-01-c2.claim: The fourth-century heresy-hunter Epiphanius quotes Maximilla as saying that after her there would be no more prophet, but the end.
